W.name: Essence Flux
W.title: Template:Data Ezreal/Essence Flux
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Essence Flux|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ezreal
|skill        = W
|icon         = Essence Flux.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ezreal}} fires an orb that shortly marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret|structure}} hit.
|blurb2       = His next attack or ability on the target detonates the mark, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. If the mark was detonated by an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{as|{{sti|mana}}}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|structure}} hit for 4 seconds.
|description2 = His next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--on-hit? on-damage?--> or {{tip|ability}} against the target detonates the mark to deal them {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 300}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
|description3 = If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability.
|cooldown     = 8
|cost         = 50
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = 1200
|speed        = 1700
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly=true}} 160
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = True
|parry        = Special
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* The application of ''Essence Flux'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage}}.
** This triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]].
** It also triggers {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applies {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
** For being {{tip|proc damage}}, it does not trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}. 
* {{tip|Block}} and {{tip|Dodge}} prevents the mark from being triggered by a basic attack.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents the mark from being triggered by an ability. If the mark is triggered by a basic attack, spell shield will prevent ''Essence Flux's'' damage.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
}}
